scope: Owner request: as part of the master audit, the Mermaid Pool (Day One) was chosen as the first area to refine to five-star standard; be comprehensive, provide a detailed framework for improvement, modify code where necessary and propose new Codex handoffs for graphics and animation. Claude repaired the overdraw that shared room layers drew on the Pool's screen (MA-VIS-009, carved from MA-VIS-008): the castle dressing's code-drawn wash, grime, drips and cracks move to a DayOneCastleGrime child hidden in rooms that author their own dirt (the Pool); one cleanup basket instead of two; the cleanup quiets the living-world layer's code motifs while mounted; the shared swimmer and Rumi's rise use the approved project-original water-ripple atlas instead of code arcs and the cleaning ring; the Pool finale drops the generic star burst; the castle letterbox fills only its bands. Two child-facing defects found in review are repaired: the room-completion clip cut into Rumi's reveal and froze her reply mid-line (MA-PLAY-006; completion now waits for the reward beat, 1.2-4.5 s), and the touring touch halo pulsed over props whose hotspots a cleanup had suspended (MA-TOUCH-003). The overdraw meter is corrected: a layer spawned during counting now counts once (the Pool's reported 255-layer burst was such a layer drawing in its real colours), connected draw callbacks count as code drawing, and Rumi's reveal is measured at real speed with the completion clip recorded as a non-play state; every game is re-measured. The Pool rises from 3/5 (19/24) to 3/5 (21/24) on the gold-star scorecard; only the OD2 look-alike review separates it from 4/5, then device, child and owner acceptance. New Codex packet docs/handoffs/codex_pool_five_star_2026-10-04/ (FRAMEWORK.md, README.md with packages P1-P8 for captures, Roshan's authored work actions, room-lit props, Rumi's rise, the swimmer, catch feedback, voice and device evidence); the earlier gold-star packet gains revision-5 status notes.

lessons.lesson: A GPU layer counter must also count nodes created during the counted frames: an effect spawned mid-count drew in its real colours and read as up to 255 layers, and a published finding quoted that artifact. A falsifiable self-test leg (a white layer added mid-count must read as one) now guards it.

Measure the moment, not the clock: at the probe's 4x time scale the 1.15 s reveal had already handed the screen to a 17 s story clip, so the 'finale' measured the clip. A state worth budgeting is waited for by its own signal and measured at real speed.

A clean reference game still needs shared layers to have an opt-out contract. An authored-dirt list and a quiet group let the Pool's screen be clean without a game-wide redesign, and other rooms can join one at a time.
A completion that starts a story clip pauses the tree, which freezes voice lines mid-word; the reward beat must finish (bounded) before the completion fires.

Holding the room completion until Rumi's reward beat ends keeps the d1_pool_clean clip between scenes instead of over one (MA-PLAY-006).
